answers.core: Possibly the "Cadillac" version of this proposal should be an editor plugin (which I'd be eager to make!). But I'd need GDScript access to `DocData` to do so.
answers.workaround: I don't think so. As far as I can tell, the internal C++ `DocData` is not accessible to GDScript and its generation could not easily be reproduced.
